name: sparx — Pest Control (Home)
tagline: A reliable, reassuring template for pest-control companies — book inspections from day one.
description: A friendly residential pest-control site built on a reliable teal-and-green palette over a clean near-white ground. Installs a working booking flow: free inspections plus general, ant/roach, rodent, termite and mosquito treatments and recurring protection plans, three licensed technicians dispatched by skill with their own hours, and a plan policy. Ships as "ShieldGuard Pest Control".
